name: com.uni-tx.economy
description: The kit's economy layer: any number of named economies, each a content-defined grouping of currencies with exchange rules and virtual purchases (costs -> rewards) granted atomically and idempotently.

samples.description: Two economies on a manual clock: grant a currency, exchange one currency into another at a content-defined rate, and buy a virtual purchase that costs currencies and pays rewards.

A uGUI wallet: one tab per economy, each listing its currencies with balances, a rate-visible exchange button, and a buy button per purchase. Needs com.uni-tx.widgets and com.uni-tx.sprite-loader; without them the sample's assembly is skipped rather than breaking the project.
